name: 🔍 AI Selector Discovery — Syrian News Aggregator

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: ⚡ Webhook Trigger: Accepts targetUrl & aggregatorBaseUrl POST payload and returns selector JSON synchronously.

nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Start manually. Set the target news URL in the next node.

nodes.name: Set Parameters
nodes.notes: ⚙️ Merges parameters from Webhook body or falls back to manual defaults

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

nodes.name: Fetch Page HTML
nodes.notes: Fetches the news website with browser-like headers

nodes.name: Clean & Condense DOM
nodes.notes: Strips noise (scripts, styles, SVG), condenses HTML to ~10KB structural skeleton

nodes.name: 🤖 LLM Analyze DOM
nodes.notes: Sends condensed DOM to GPT-4o-mini to discover selectors. Returns JSON.

nodes.name: Parse LLM Result
nodes.notes: Parses JSON from LLM response, validates selector structure

nodes.name: Save to Aggregator (Optional)
nodes.notes: Optional: sends results back to the aggregator API

nodes.name: Log Failure
nodes.notes: Detection failed — check the LLM raw output for debugging
